reason: The row's trigger is a funding event that is 15 months old. Fairmat's last round is the EUR 51.5M Series B (EUR 26.5M equity co-led by Bpifrance and Slate VC with Cape Capital, Singular, Temasek, CNP and Pictet, plus EUR 25M of European Investment Bank venture debt) announced on 2 April 2025 (tech.eu, JEC, CompositesWorld, EIB project page) — 455 days before the 1 July 2026 date this row sits on. No 2026 raise, valuation or corporate event was found: the only 2026 news is the set of six partnerships announced at JEC World in early March 2026 (Syensqo prepreg scrap, an Airbus end-of-life R&D contract signed at the end of 2025, Etex, Babolat, Launchpad O&P, Billy Footwear), which is 118 days before the row and is a customer-pipeline update, not a capital or identity inflection. Nothing inside the 90-day window. The row's named person (Benjamin Saada, Founder & CEO) is correct. Two further cautions for any re-queue: Fairmat has no motorsport partnership on record, and the recycled-carbon-fibre lane in F1 is already occupied by team-led programmes (McLaren's recycled carbon fibre trial at the 2023 United States GP; Mercedes-AMG Petronas with INEOS, Toray, Syensqo and Sigmatex for 2025), so a MODE A workstream would have to be negotiated against those in-house efforts. Not built; re-surface only on a Series C or a plant opening announced by Fairmat itself.
